# Julio Cuba — Electric Violinist

> International electric violinist performing at luxury events, weddings and exclusive venues in Dubai, Spain and across Europe.

## About

Julio Cuba is a professional electric violinist with over 30 years of experience performing at high-end events worldwide. He specialises in live electric violin performances that combine classical virtuosity with modern electronic production, creating an unforgettable atmosphere for luxury occasions.

## Services

- **Weddings**: Elegant live performances for ceremonies, receptions and celebrations
- **Corporate Events**: Gala dinners, product launches, conferences and brand activations
- **Private Parties**: Birthday parties, anniversaries and intimate gatherings
- **Fashion Shows**: Live musical accompaniment for runway presentations
- **Clubs & Venues**: High-energy performances alongside DJs at premium nightlife venues
- **Destination Events**: Available internationally — Dubai, Ibiza, London, Marbella and beyond

## Locations

- Dubai, UAE
- Spain (nationwide)
- Europe (international bookings available)

## Music Style

Julio Cuba's repertoire spans classical, pop, electronic and dance music, all performed on electric violin. His signature style fuses live violin with electronic beats, creating an energetic and sophisticated sound perfect for luxury events.
